keyword: where is the world baseball classic being played
claims: The 2026 World Baseball Classic runs from March 5 to March 17, 2026.
The 2026 World Baseball Classic is being played across four global venues.
LoanDepot park in Miami, Florida hosts Finals, Semifinals, and Pool D of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Daikin Park in Houston, Texas hosts Quarterfinals and Pool B of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Tokyo Dome in Tokyo, Japan hosts Pool C of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan, Puerto Rico hosts Pool A of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
The semifinals and final of the 2026 World Baseball Classic are being hosted at loanDepot park in Miami.
LoanDepot park in Miami, Florida hosts Pool D, Quarterfinals, Semifinals, and Final of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
Daikin Park in Houston, Texas hosts Pool B and Quarterfinals of the 2026 World Baseball Classic.
